requirements.requirement: Sticky product shell with certification navigation, account controls, mock CTA, persistent theme, feedback, and restrained footer.
requirements.intentional_difference: Guest navigation includes public certification facts while protected learning routes still require authentication.
requirements.rationale: Public exam discovery is informational and does not expose private study content.

requirements.requirement: Editorial-first home with concise hero, two CTAs, truthful proof, certification discovery, and globe.
requirements.intentional_difference: Signed-in candidates receive a subordinate prep command center for Due Today, mistakes, readiness, and exam pacing rather than a purely static editorial page.
requirements.rationale: The extension improves the learner loop while preserving the editorial hero and truthful public state.

requirements.requirement: Public certification chooser clearly separates official certification existence from product study-guide availability.
requirements.intentional_difference: Only the focused SnowPro Core, Advanced Data Engineer, and Advanced Architect paths are promoted in this product view.
requirements.rationale: A focused catalog prevents unsupported paths from implying complete preparation content.

requirements.requirement: Certification cards and exam guides use source-verified facts and preserve unknown fields as null/not_verified rather than guessing.
requirements.intentional_difference: Unverified item count, duration, item format, or scoring fields are omitted from the UI.
requirements.rationale: Official-source provenance is stronger than copying facts from a third-party preparation site.

requirements.requirement: COF-C03 curriculum exposes five weighted domains and nineteen task statements in the shared study shell.
requirements.rationale: Canonical blueprint is the product syllabus.

requirements.requirement: Domain detail shows weight, task rows, active sidebar expansion, and task completion state.
requirements.rationale: Completion ticks close the later parity gap without adding an N+1 request pattern.

requirements.requirement: Task lesson includes objective, knowledge, key concept, decision rules, traps, worked example, practice scenario, build exercise, sources, completion, drill, and previous/next navigation.
requirements.intentional_difference: Lesson completion updates the expanded sidebar immediately.
requirements.rationale: Maintains one coherent task study loop.

requirements.requirement: Progress shows readiness, lesson/practice/drill evidence, domain progress, Due Today, mistakes, study plan, calibration, and mock remediation.
requirements.intentional_difference: Snowflake Brain extends the recorded readiness panel with persisted SRS, mistakes, calibration, plan, and remediation.
requirements.rationale: These are evidence-driven learner controls rather than decorative dashboard metrics.

requirements.requirement: Targeted drill uses a dedicated pre-start screen, domain selection, summary signals, and no auto-launch.
requirements.rationale: Matches recorded setup intent using current Snowflake bank boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Diagnostic has a pre-start explanation, domain coverage, expectations, and deliberate start CTA.
requirements.intentional_difference: Diagnostic count follows Snowflake Brain entitlement/product rules rather than copying the reference count.
requirements.rationale: Product entitlement is authoritative.

requirements.requirement: Practice provides diagnostic, targeted drill, SRS review, quick mock, and full mock while enforcing tier boundaries.
requirements.intentional_difference: SRS/Due Today and governed entitlement logic extend beyond the recorded product.
requirements.rationale: Adds durable learning and security value.

requirements.requirement: Mock start detects interrupted sittings, supports resume/discard, quick/full selection, format, weights, instructions, and explicit start.
requirements.rationale: Persistent server-owned sittings satisfy the interaction contract.

requirements.requirement: Dedicated timed exam player preserves answers, flags, timer, free navigation, mobile navigator, autosave, resume, and answer secrecy before submit.
requirements.rationale: Server-owned sitting state is stronger than browser-only persistence.

requirements.requirement: Results expose score/readiness, domain performance, answer review, explanations, flagged state, remediation, history, and separate unanswered filtering.
requirements.intentional_difference: Retry-missed is represented by targeted drill and mock remediation rather than a duplicate result-page question mode.
requirements.rationale: Existing remediation preserves the same learner outcome with stronger task linkage.

requirements.requirement: Quick Reference has domain landing cards, print cue, usage note, and task-level decision/trap summaries.
requirements.rationale: Current implementation preserves task-linked review rather than static copied sheets.

requirements.requirement: Glossary provides domain landing, searchable task-level terminology, aliases, task context, and lesson linkage.
requirements.intentional_difference: Definitions remain task/objective-oriented instead of introducing unverified encyclopedia text.
requirements.rationale: Avoids manufacturing source-less definitions.

requirements.requirement: Build exercises support scenario, difficulty/time, steps, starter SQL, hints, validation checks, expected output, solution, teardown, tags, and traps.
requirements.intentional_difference: Deterministic hints and executable validation replace an open-ended AI Build Coach.
requirements.rationale: This provides cheaper, auditable coaching without hallucination or prompt-governance risk.

requirements.requirement: Reference page groups concise Snowflake resources and opens external documentation safely.
requirements.rationale: Snowflake-specific source links replace third-party resource content.

requirements.requirement: Journal provides certification-focused editorial cards and technical articles without copying reference articles.
requirements.intentional_difference: Content is original and Snowflake-specific; this wave does not become an SEO factory.
requirements.rationale: Preserves useful information architecture without copying expression.

requirements.requirement: Floating feedback action opens an accessible title/category/description/email experience with persistent backend submission.
requirements.intentional_difference: Full-height drawer follows the later explicit product instruction rather than the smaller recorded panel geometry.
requirements.rationale: Later user instruction supersedes the recording geometry.

requirements.requirement: Light/dark theme applies across routes and persists.
requirements.rationale: Theme persistence remains local presentation state, not authentication authority.

requirements.requirement: Learner and exam experiences adapt across desktop/tablet/mobile without horizontal overflow or clipped controls.
requirements.rationale: Mobile behavior follows the same design system where the recording lacked complete mobile evidence.

requirements.requirement: Keyboard semantics, focus, accessible labels, reduced motion, and structural accessibility baseline are preserved.
requirements.rationale: Accessibility is a product requirement, not pixel parity.

requirements.requirement: Home uses real projected geography and privacy-safe aggregate activity with truthful fallback and no fabricated learner locations.
requirements.intentional_difference: No pre-seeded city dots or fabricated social proof are displayed.
requirements.rationale: Truthful privacy-safe state is superior to visually matching invented live activity.
requirements.external_dependency: Trusted aggregate telemetry is optional for live markers

requirements.requirement: Candidate sessions fail closed for study content and support email/password plus governed Google OIDC.
requirements.intentional_difference: Authentication was added as a production security boundary beyond the visual reference.
requirements.rationale: Private commercial study content requires durable identity.
requirements.external_dependency: Production Google OAuth credentials for live Google sign-in

requirements.requirement: Email verification, recovery, email/password changes, session management, export, and deletion are implemented.
requirements.rationale: Production account ownership and privacy controls extend beyond reference parity.
requirements.external_dependency: Production email webhook credentials for real delivery

requirements.requirement: Free, Premium 100/250/500, and Exam Pack entitlements are server-authoritative.
requirements.rationale: Browser state cannot grant paid access.

requirements.requirement: Stripe Checkout/webhook/Portal mapping is implemented with signature, idempotency, price authority, and safe entitlement transitions.
requirements.rationale: Code is implemented; production enablement requires Stripe account readiness and deployment secrets.
requirements.external_dependency: Stripe onboarding, STRIPE_* secrets, Vercel environment provisioning

requirements.requirement: Private 1,200-question COF-C03 artifact remains outside Git and is imported through immutable governed releases with answer secrecy and entitlement boundaries.
requirements.intentional_difference: Question content is intentionally absent from repository/static artifacts.
requirements.rationale: Confidential commercial bank content must remain a separate deployment boundary.
requirements.external_dependency: Private signed HTTPS source, production migration credential, actual QA import, human SME approval, activation

requirements.requirement: Question versions, release snapshots, source freshness, automated QA, human editorial review, SME approval, staging, activation, and rollback remain distinct.
requirements.intentional_difference: Automated checks never impersonate a human Snowflake SME.
requirements.rationale: Human editorial authority is a deliberate governance boundary.
requirements.external_dependency: Actual SME approval per production release

requirements.requirement: Adaptive readiness uses evidence, calibration, coverage, retention, runway, and recommendation logic without claiming pass probability.
requirements.intentional_difference: The reference's simpler readiness presentation is replaced by evidence-aware confidence and sparse-data handling.
requirements.rationale: Avoids misleading pass-probability claims.

requirements.requirement: Attempts feed SRS, mistake notebook, confidence calibration, study plan, and mock remediation.
requirements.intentional_difference: This persisted learning loop is a Snowflake Brain extension beyond the reference recording.
requirements.rationale: Turns practice history into actionable retention/remediation.

requirements.requirement: Candidate can verify a SnowPro credential via issuer-backed Credly evidence with private-by-default talent visibility.
requirements.intentional_difference: Recruiter marketplace and document upload are not represented as live.
requirements.rationale: Verified candidate-owned credential foundation is useful now; recruiter-side PII workflows require separate review.

requirements.requirement: Active V26 states independence, no live/leaked/recalled exam content, provenance principles, trademark attribution, correction process, and no false registration claims.
requirements.intentional_difference: Retired beta-demo legal files were not resurrected or mechanically merged.
requirements.rationale: Ports useful policy intent into the active V26 architecture.
requirements.external_dependency: Qualified legal review for actual filings/enforcement strategy if pursued

requirements.requirement: Structured logs, request IDs, health/readiness, metrics, alert sinks, and production soak tooling exist.
requirements.rationale: Internal implementation is tested; external alert delivery requires deployment-owned destination credentials.
requirements.external_dependency: Production observability webhook/token and external delivery proof

requirements.requirement: Auth boundary, same-origin mutation checks, rate limits, headers, least privilege, SAST, dependency audit, DAST, hostile-subscriber and bank-isolation controls remain blocking release gates.
requirements.rationale: Security requirements are product engineering, not visual parity.
requirements.external_dependency: Hosted attacker/victim proof after active production bank

requirements.requirement: Vercel/Neon deployment, migrations, least-privilege runtime, backup/restore, release gates, and rollback procedures are defined and automated where possible.
requirements.rationale: Repository automation is complete but hosted credential rotation, exact deployment verification, and production soak are external release evidence.
requirements.external_dependency: GitHub/Vercel secrets, runtime role provisioning, exact-head deployment, final production soak

requirements.requirement: Expanded task navigation visibly distinguishes completed lessons.
requirements.intentional_difference: Completion state is candidate-owned and fetched once per relevant page.
requirements.rationale: Useful later reference evolution with direct learner value.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate Concept Check, Exam Sim, and Build Coach interaction ideas without cloning their UI or content.
requirements.intentional_difference: Inline scenario + governed task drill + deterministic lab coaching replace three copied mode buttons.
requirements.rationale: Existing architecture delivers the learning outcomes with lower cost, lower hallucination risk, and stronger governed-bank reuse.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate testimonials/social proof.
requirements.intentional_difference: Current examples are explicitly labeled workflow examples, not claimed candidate testimonials or pass proof.
requirements.rationale: No real consented candidate testimonial corpus was provided; fabrication is prohibited.
requirements.external_dependency: Real consented candidate evidence if testimonials are added later

requirements.requirement: Evaluate waitlist capture for coming-soon certifications.
requirements.intentional_difference: Current coming-soon paths link to factual exam guides rather than collecting marketing email consent.
requirements.rationale: Waitlists introduce consent/email lifecycle concerns and are not required for preparation completeness.

requirements.requirement: Recruiter accounts, company verification, search, saved lists, introduction requests, resume/contact release, recruiter subscriptions, and ATS integration.
requirements.intentional_difference: Recruiter-side marketplace is deliberately excluded from certification reverse-engineering closure.
requirements.rationale: PII, company verification, contact release, abuse controls, and marketplace security require a separate launch review.
requirements.external_dependency: Separate marketplace product decision and privacy/security review
